Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1 stated that
Driver 2 was turning left across the lane of travel and that the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side of
Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported a wrist injury from the impact and was transported for evaluation. A Passenger
was also present in Driver 1's vehicle and was identified at the scene by both drivers and by independent witnesses,
who saw the vehicle and the passenger before and after the crash. Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events as
Driver 1 described them. Photographs taken at the scene show damage concentrated on the driver's side, which is
consistent with a left turn into the path of an oncoming vehicle. Officers observed no prior damage to Driver 1's
vehicle, and no earlier collision involving it was reported. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy
covering the vehicle. Based on the scene evidence and statements, the injury reported is consistent with the
mechanics of this crash.
